checklist.text: Generators or UPS, what they serve and how they are tested
Fuels on site (gas, oil, LPG), how much is stored and where, and their emergency shut-offs
Refrigeration plant and its refrigerant, chillers, and cooling towers with their construction and whether combustible fill is protected
Each transformer's type, rating, oil or dry type, and separation from buildings
How waste and effluent are collected, stored and treated, and where combustible waste builds up
Check food court and restaurant kitchens, grease ducts and hood suppression

observations.note: hot work permit form reviewed - no fire watch requirement during or after hot work
no formal FP system impairment programme. isolations approved by tech service team only, no impairment permit
loading bay cardboard waste removed daily, area clear at time of visit
kitchen hoods wet chemical, tenant maintained, not linked to main FA. tenants clean filters quarterly; common exhaust ducts cleaned yearly by FM contractor
Chubb service contract for FP. monthly pump run, monthly smoke det test (100%), monthly roller shutter test, annual flow switch test
2 incoming 22kV feeders. 10 silicon oil tx, ~25-30% load, L2 units back each other up, L8 units back each other up. IR thermography + PD test + DGA yearly by LEW contractor
chillers 5 x 1000RT + 2 x 500RT, 3 x 1000RT run day, peak 2400-2600RT. spare capacity
housekeeping generally good most areas seen
boundary exposures light - nbr malls + MRT 10m, via underground links. lightning moderate, LPS installed. flood low - sump pumps, flood barriers + sensors at link, tested yearly w PUB
ERP for fire, bomb, pandemic. 6-man ERT. MOC involves stakeholders + risk assessment
